summary: Iteration 12: tested Restock Reminders and Stock Change History on the backend and in the UI. Backend: new tests/test_restock_stock_history.py passes 18/18. It covers 401s on all 5 /api/retailers/* endpoints; finance getting 403 on PUT contact, POST reminder and POST stock-check (finance also gets 403 on both GETs because it has no marketplace view permission); 422 for an invalid email; 400 without a contact; 400 for SLOT, which has no out-of-stock products; a null email clearing the contact; the stock-history shape (12 Pointek states, 101 in total); and cron 401s with no Bearer or a wrong one. Manual checks also passed. Change detection: I set the Pointek 'Hisense Washing Machine 10kg' stock_state to in_stock, and the stock-check then returned {products:101, changes:1, new_products:0} with a stock_events doc in_stock->out_of_stock. A repeat stock-check returned 429. Cron stock-check and restock-reminders return 202, and a duplicate X-Webhook-Id returns duplicate:true. The restock-reminders cron ran once with sent:1, while delivered@resend.dev was the only contact. UI: on Pointek detail, stock-history-list and stock-event-<id> render the event, and retailer-oos-since shows 'out since Nov 5, 2026'. Saving delivered@resend.dev makes the send button appear. Sending shows the toast 'Reminder sent to delivered@resend.dev (6 products)' and retailer-last-reminder updates. Clearing the email hides the send button, the send button is disabled while the field is being edited, and SLOT's send button is disabled. An invalid email shows a 422 toast. Mobile 390px: retailer detail and the list are both 390 scrollWidth, with no overflow. Regression: the Dashboard oos-banner ('9 marketplace products are out of stock') and Marketplace load. I found two bugs and fixed both (details in rca).

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. The 10-minute 429 never fired. A second reminder sent 10s after the first returned 200 and sent a duplicate email.

minor.issue: No unique index on product_id or retailer_id. If a cron stock-check and a manual one run at the same moment on an empty or new product set, they can insert duplicate stock_state docs.
retailer_id is not checked against the live retailers, so a contact can be saved for a retailer that doesn't exist.
'1 of your products are out of stock' is ungrammatical when only 1 product is out. The body handles the singular, but the subject does not.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. After you saved a contact on the detail page and clicked Back, the list card still showed 'No contact email' (a stale hint).

issues: The breadcrumb or top bar shows 'Dashboard' instead of 'Retailers' when /admin/retailers/<id> is loaded directly.
Stock history and last-reminder times use the browser's timezone, not Lagos, while the copy says 'Lagos time'. Consider formatting in Africa/Lagos.
The gold 'No contact email' hint on white has low contrast.

action_items: Review and keep the tester's fix in retail_ext.py: compute the 429 window with datetime.now(timezone.utc).
Review and keep the tester's fix in Retailers.jsx: reload contacts when going back to the list.
Optional: add unique indexes on stock_state.product_id and retailer_contacts.retailer_id.
Optional: use the singular in the email subject when only 1 product is out.
Optional: fix the breadcrumb label on retailer detail, and show times in Lagos time.
critical_code_review_comments: retail_ext.py send_restock_now compared ISO strings with different UTC offsets: stored sent_at is +00:00, while the threshold was datetime.now(LAGOS).isoformat(), which is +01:00. That pushed the threshold 1h into the future, so the check never matched. Comparing strings only works when every value uses the same offset.
Retailers.jsx is one component instance shared by the retailers and retailers/:rid routes, so its useContacts effect ran only once. It needed a reload when rid changes.
Weekly cron run_restock_reminders doesn't respect the 10-minute manual cooldown. That is acceptable, but a manual send just before Monday 9am will mean a double email.

success_rate.backend: 95% (1 bug, fixed and retested: 429 now returned)
